name: Harsha Engineers International Ltd
title: Harsha Engineers International Ltd - 543600 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Engineering revenue up ~14% in FY26 to INR1,444 crore with EBITDA INR264 crore; management guides mid-teens India growth and only maintaining margins, with Advantek still loss-making and Romania EBITDA negative.

capex.quote: about INR30-INR40 crore of maintenance capex in India in this current financial year

triggers.label: Advantek sales to grow 3x in FY27
triggers.quote: we should see the sale from this unit growing at least 3x in FY '27

triggers.label: Pass-through on metal costs ~4 months
triggers.quote: on an average on four months everything gets passed through

triggers.label: Europe demand slowly improving, cost still negative
triggers.quote: we are also evaluating can how long we can do with this kind of negative margins

triggers.label: FY27 India growth mid-teens; margins maintained
triggers.quote: we should be able to at least maintain our current margin profile

guidance.quote: we should achieve an overall double-digit growth in top line
the growth in India engineering would be little bit more aggressive, somewhat in mid -teens
we have a very aggressive growth plan in tune of 25 % to 30% in this segment
over the period of 2 to 3 years, our expectation is overall increase of 100 to 200 basis points in our EBITDA
This project should come in operation in H2 FY '28

red_flags.label: Romania negative EBITDA; subsidiary losses INR9 crore combined
red_flags.quote: Romania continues to perform below par as it is still having negative EBITDA

red_flags.label: Management evasive on EBITDA guidance and export breakdown
red_flags.quote: EBITDA, we do not know, sir . We continue to say, Saket, the blended EBITDA only

red_flags.label: Q4 consolidated growth 27% mostly from Solar
red_flags.quote: 27 is including Solar, and if I remove the Solar business, it is 15.7%

evasions.topic: Export growth breakdown into demand/wallet share/new programs
evasions.quote: we do not share this data to the investors
EBITDA, we do not know, sir . We continue to say, Saket, the blended EBITDA only
